description: Improve layer delete UX with inline confirmation, redesign world rename inline UI, and fix scale dropdown functionality

userStories.title: Implement inline delete confirmation for layers
userStories.description: Replace the modal dialog for layer deletion with inline confirmation. When delete is clicked, hide other buttons and show 'Delete' and 'X' (cancel) buttons inline next to the layer name.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking trash icon hides other buttons (eye, lock, move up/down, opacity)
Shows 'Delete' button (red/danger color) and 'X' button (cancel) inline
Layer name remains visible during confirmation
Click 'X' cancels and restores original state
Click 'Delete' removes the layer from store
Cancel also happens on Escape key
Smooth transitions between states
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Redesign inline rename for world title in sidebar
userStories.description: Completely redesign the inline rename UI for the world title in sidebar header. Make it more visually appealing and functional.
acceptanceCriteria: Better visual feedback when editing (border, background color change)
Input field matches the design system (rounded-sm, proper spacing)
Clear save/Cancel indicators or auto-save on blur
Escape key cancels editing
Enter key saves changes
Visual distinction between view and edit modes
Smooth transition between modes
Matches fantasy RPG theme
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Fix scale dropdown not showing other values
userStories.description: The scale dropdown in Properties Panel doesn't show other scale options when clicked. Fix the dropdown functionality to properly display and select all scale values.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown opens when clicking the scale row
All three options are visible: 1:1000, 1:500, 1:100
Clicking an option selects it and closes dropdown
Selected option is highlighted (gold accent background)
Dropdown closes when clicking outside
Scale value updates correctly in the store
Visual feedback for selected state
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Test and validate all UX improvements
userStories.description: Run quality gates and verify all UX improvements work correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Inline delete for layers works smoothly
World rename has better visual design
Scale dropdown shows all options
All interactions feel smooth and responsive
Linting passes (npm run lint)
Typecheck passes (npx tsc)
Build succeeds (npm run build)
